subject.title: [Feature]: Matrix QA lifecycle parity across Tuwunel and Crabline

question: Should Matrix QA lifecycle parity be accepted through the linked PR's substrate-layer controller and API shape, or should that PR be revised before this tracker closes?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested lifecycle contract and the open implementation changes the QA Matrix public import boundary, which automated cleanup should not decide for maintainers.

options.title: Review linked PR as implementation
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101055 if maintainers accept the lifecycle controller and exported API shape.

options.title: Revise API boundary first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask the PR to keep helpers internal or choose a different import surface before merge.

options.title: Reject this direction for now
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR only if maintainers decide Matrix QA lifecycle parity is not wanted in this form.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as implementation
recommendation.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101055 if maintainers accept the lifecycle controller and exported API shape.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the tracker, recent Matrix QA work, and the linked implementation PR, making them the best first routing point for the direction call.
